evidence.title: Sample: Alder and Vale discuss a fictional evening-bus proposal
evidence.text: Authored demonstration text, not a news excerpt. In this invented scenario, Mira Alder and Rowan Vale offer different approaches to an evening-bus timetable. The numeric leaning inputs were chosen directly by the fixture author; this text was not classified or scored.

evidence.text: Authored demonstration text. A fictional workshop compares two proposed station layouts. It exists only to exercise evidence links and the production evidence sanitizer, not to document a real event.
